fieldValues.title: A subdomain does not inherit its parent's personas, axes and poles
fieldValues.statement: I need a subdomain to start with its parent's axes and poles and the parent's personas offered, and then localise the names and keep only the primary personas. Today each persona-in-domain and axis-in-domain is copied by hand with a refines link, so inheritance is a convention agents follow unevenly, and a parent domain cannot show the influences from its subdomains and siblings or hold the general problems its subdomains assume.
